title: Microsoft Teams: new content-sharing layouts for Teams events
summary: The briefing passes: its layout description, availability and licensing agree with the roadmap and the cited Microsoft documentation. Both event-policy paths and PowerShell commands are documented, and independent searches found no administrator control specifically for these layouts.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Teams admin center > Meetings > Events policies > policy > Events up to 1k attendees controls creation of events with up to 1,000 attendees, such as webinars.
claims.quote: In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Events policies. Select an existing policy or create a new one. For events with up to 1,000 attendees, such as webinars, turn the Events up to 1k attendees toggle On or Off.

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsEventsPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowWebinars Disabled prevents organisers assigned that policy from creating events with up to 1,000 attendees.
claims.quote: To prevent organizers with this policy from creating events with up to 1,000 attendees, run the following command: Set-CsTeamsEventsPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowWebinars Disabled

claims.where: controls[2].ui; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Teams admin center > Meetings > Events policies > policy > Events optimized for a large audience controls creation of events optimised for large audiences, such as town halls.
claims.quote: In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Events policies. Select an existing policy or create a new one. For events optimized for large audiences, such as town halls, turn the Events optimized for a large audience toggle On or Off.

claims.where: controls[2].api; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsEventsPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowTownhalls Disabled prevents organisers assigned that policy from creating events optimised for large audiences.
claims.quote: To prevent organizers with this policy from creating events optimized for large audiences, run the following command: Set-CsTeamsEventsPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowTownhalls Disabled

claims.where: controls[1].note; controls[2].note; Governance controls
claims.claim: Changing these event-creation policy settings to Off after an event is scheduled prevents the user from running or starting the event.
claims.quote: If you change the value to Off after a user schedules an event, they can't run or start the event.
